pull.title: feat: reference-implemented random/bytes provider
pull.body:
## Summary
Core wasm xorshift32 fill (non-crypto packaging); JVM SecureRandom host helper; validate-manifest + artifact digest tests.

## Evidence
`clojure -M:test` — 4 tests, 15 assertions, 0 failures

## Notes
- Definition CID **unchanged** (`bafyreidauidawvzfmrbe2wi2dn62flk2sejjpfp6omszbvhwjqfeslk7ai`)
- `:signature :reference-unsigned`
- Production hosts inject OS CSPRNG

## Related
- ADR-0001 allowlist `random/bytes`

diff --git a/src/kotoba/capability/random/bytes/provider.clj b/src/kotoba/capability/random/bytes/provider.clj
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d85ee69
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/kotoba/capability/random/bytes/provider.clj
@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+(ns kotoba.capability.random.bytes.provider
+  "JVM reference host provider for actor:host field \"random_bytes\".
+
+  ABI: (ptr, len) -> bytes-written|-1 — pure surface here is
+  `(fill! byte-array) -> same array` using SecureRandom.
+  Memory-backed injection remains the embedder's job."
+  (:import [java.security SecureRandom]))
+
+(def ^:private rng (delay (SecureRandom.)))
+
+(defn fill!
+  "Fill a byte array with CSPRNG bytes; returns the same array."
+  [^bytes dest]
+  (.nextBytes ^SecureRandom @rng dest)
+  dest)
+
+(defn random-bytes
+  "Allocate and fill `n` cryptographically secure random bytes."
+  [n]
+  (let [bs (byte-array (int n))]
+    (fill! bs)))
+
+(defn host-export
+  []
+  {:module "kotoba"
+   :field "random_bytes"
+   :params [:i32 :i32]
+   :result :i32
+   :fn random-bytes})

diff --git a/test/kotoba/capability/random/bytes_test.clj b/test/kotoba/capability/random/bytes_test.clj
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..fd146d4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/kotoba/capability/random/bytes_test.clj
@@ -0,0 +1,46 @@
+(ns kotoba.capability.random.bytes-test
+  (:require [clojure.test :refer [deftest is]]
+            [clojure.java.io :as io]
+            [kotoba.capability.random.bytes :as capability]
+            [kotoba.capability.random.bytes.provider :as provider]
+            [kotoba.core.capability-repository :as repository]
+            [kotoba.core.contracts :as contracts])
+  (:import [java.security MessageDigest]))
+
+(defn- sha256-file [f]
+  (let [md (MessageDigest/getInstance "SHA-256")
+        bytes (.digest md (.readAllBytes (io/input-stream f)))]
+    (apply str (map #(format "%02x" (bit-and % 0xff)) bytes))))
+
+(deftest manifest-conforms-as-reference-implemented
+  (is (= :reference-implemented (:capability/provider-status capability/manifest)))
+  (is (= "random/bytes" (:capability/id capability/manifest)))
+  (is (= "bafyreidauidawvzfmrbe2wi2dn62flk2sejjpfp6omszbvhwjqfeslk7ai"
+         (:capability/definition-cid capability/manifest)))
+  (is (= [] (repository/validate-manifest (contracts/capability-contract) capability/manifest))))
+
+(deftest artifact-sha256-matches-bytes
+  (let [path (io/file "artifacts/provider.core.wasm")
+        declared (get-in capability/manifest [:capability/artifact :sha256])]
+    (is (.isFile path))
+    (is (= declared (sha256-file path)))))
+
+(deftest artifact-exports-match-host-abi
+  (let [exports (get-in capability/manifest [:capability/artifact :exports])
+        abi (get-in capability/manifest [:capability/artifact :host-abi])]
+    (is (= {"random_bytes" {:params [:i32 :i32], :result :i32}} exports))
+    (is (= {:module "kotoba", :field "random_bytes"} abi))))
+
+(deftest jvm-reference-provider-fills-length
+  (let [export (provider/host-export)
+        f (:fn export)
+        a (f 32)
+        b (f 32)]
+    (is (= "kotoba" (:module export)))
+    (is (= "random_bytes" (:field export)))
+    (is (= [:i32 :i32] (:params export)))
+    (is (= :i32 (:result export)))
+    (is (= 32 (alength a)))
+    (is (= 32 (alength b)))
+    ;; Extremely unlikely two independent CSPRNG 32-byte draws match
+    (is (not (java.util.Arrays/equals a b)))))
